entry.title: Breast cancer survivors could avoid lifelong heart medication, research suggests
entry.summary: Many breast cancer survivors whose treatment caused them to develop problems with their heart function can safely stop their medication after their heart recovers, and most won't need to continue treatment long term, according to a study presented at the European Society of Cardiology Congress in Munich.
